description: Get real-time upcoming departures (line, direction, platform, delay) for a Berlin/Brandenburg transit stop within a time window. Stop ID comes from transport-rest.transit.search_locations or transport-rest.transit.nearby_stops. Data: v6.bvg.transport.rest (community HAFAS wrapper for BVG), no auth required, 100 req/min.

duration_minutes.description: Time window in minutes to look ahead for departures (default 60, max 180).

results.description: Maximum number of departures to return (default 20, max 100).

stop_id.description: Stop/station ID to fetch departures for, obtained from transport-rest.location_search or transport-rest.nearby_stops (e.g. "900100003").

when.description: ISO 8601 date-time to fetch departures for instead of now (e.g. "2026-09-01T08:00:00+02:00").

name: transport-rest.transit.departures

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get Real-Time Stop Departures
